verdict.rationale: The IPO's public gov.uk pages link to a 'Track a trade mark' service and let you search by trade mark number, plus a weekly journal of accepted applications, so a founder can check trade mark status. The evidence is only link titles and one-line mentions, though, and covers trade marks only. Missing for 10: any documented status lookup for patent or design applications, detail on what status information the tracking service shows, and hands-on or independent confirmation that the lookup works.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: To find trade mark applications accepted in the last week, check: Intellectual Property Office's online trade marks journal
